launcher.notes: Crash-card freshness gate (old crash logs never re-show), real close-after-launch, and a fully detached game process - closing or even Task-Manager-ending the launcher can no longer crash Minecraft. Bundles Client v3.0.0 (the KUI release).

notes: Client v3.2.4 'Lighthouse': the boot now prints an unambiguous identity line ('[Kinetrix] Client v3.2.4 boot | mobile-safe mode ON (markers: ...)') and the first UI frame traces every render step via [Kinetrix][boot-trace] lines - the previous crash report could not prove WHICH jar the phone was running because PojavLauncher launches skip the auto-updater and old jars logged identically. Everything in the crash window (hero logo quad -> first text draw -> SDF underline) is either the already-shipped mobile-safe path (vanilla font instead of AWT freetype natives) or proven-on-device vanilla mechanics. Also: Graphics2D-parity clipping fix in the pure-Java skin converter, verified by a 21-case JDK8 test battery plus a device-env simulation.
